svg.title: PathPlanner's copy of the robot
svg.desc: Animated. Two cards list what PathPlanner uses to plan a path: the motor, the gearing, the wheel size, the module positions, the current limit, the mass and the moment of inertia. One is PathPlanner's own file, the other the robot code in YAGSL. The gearing is changed in the code but stays old in PathPlanner's file. Below, along a path, a dashed outline shows where the path wants the robot and a solid robot shows where it really is: the real robot falls behind, an orange error gap grows between them, and the path controller chases it until the robot catches up at the end.
svg.text: PathPlanner plans every auto from its own file, and nothing keeps it in step with the code.
where the path wants the robot
the error the path controller chases
Change the gearing in YAGSL and forget PathPlanner, and every auto is
